name: o01_oceanic_light_wx
title: Oceanic sectors, isolated storms, merges at TIGGI and SAMAR
description: Oceanic North + Oceanic South band-boxed, near capacity: southbound Europe-South America and Canaries traffic on UN873, UN866 and RUNAX-IBALU-SAMAR, northbound South America / Canaries traffic on the SAMAR-BEXAL, SAMAR-TIGGI, VASTO-BAROK and VASTO-NIDEB-TIGGI RAD routings, NIPRI-NIDEB-ROLRO traffic from the Azores. A few isolated moderate storms in Oceanic North.
design_notes: Planted: AZU8711 (SAMAR-TIGGI) and VLG6703 (VASTO-NIDEB-TIGGI) merge at TIGGI at FL380 22 s apart; IBE6011 (UN873) and DLH518 (RUNAX-IBALU-SAMAR) merge at SAMAR at FL350; TAM8065 (M.86) overtakes AFR418 (M.80) on UN866 at FL370, 12 NM behind at KUBIL (a sleeper: the loss comes about 15 minutes later); RZO131 (NIPRI-NIDEB-ROLRO) crosses VLG7831 on UN873 at FL330; TVF7724 (UN873, FL370) reports unable RVSM at T+30:00 and passes AVA10 (northbound FL380) 2-3 NM abeam 20 NM before SAMAR. Request trap: TAP104 (northbound, FL340) asks FL380 when KLM793 is leaving BEXAL southbound at FL350 on the same line.
